summary: Current source selects SDD Artifacts, Commands, Cli and Knowledge as the coherent 2.3.0 set. FS.GG.Contracts remains an independently owned/versioned published dependency pinned exactly to 7.6.0; release resolves and compares the four SDD source versions and does not republish Contracts as an SDD member. Other source pins include FsQuint 0.1.0, Governance.Config 0.3.0 and owner-sourced skill packages. Optional Governance execution does not mean the lightweight Config package reference is absent. Source release metadata, publisher definitions and exact dependency locks are implementation contracts; fresh immutable archive/readback and installed qualification are separate evidence.
title: Four SDD members reuse independent Contracts
